semiconductor_relevance: High — Kanematsu Corporation is a trading company specializing in semiconductor and LCD manufacturing equipment, with a focus on Japanese and Singaporean technologies.
summary: Kanematsu Corporation is a trading company that supplies a wide range of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including IC test handlers and various process equipment. They also engage in in-house development to enhance technologies to meet industry standards and customer needs.
capabilities: IC test handlers by NS Technologies

regional_presence.Japan: Kanematsu has a strong presence in Japan, dealing primarily with Japanese equipment manufacturers.
regional_presence.Singapore: They also collaborate with Singaporean companies for various manufacturing systems.
